params.name: acl
params.description: A map of IDs to strings which describe how the template may be accessed. Currently there is no authoritative list of in-use values. See existing templates for examples.

params.name: agent_id
params.description: ID of the explorer which may execute the template.

params.name: client_id
params.description: ID of the account which owns the template.

params.name: created_at
params.description: Unix timestamp value indicating when the template was created.

params.name: created_by
params.description: The username of the account which created the template.

params.name: created_by_user_id
params.description: The ID of the account which created the template.

params.name: cruncher_id
params.description: ID of the runZero cruncher the task is executing on.

params.name: custom_integration_id
params.description: The ID of the custom integration source, if the last task executed with this template was an import of Asset Data.

params.name: error
params.description: The error message, if any, of the last task using the template.

params.name: global
params.description: Whether the template is globally available to all organizations.

params.name: grace_period
params.description: Additional time beyond hard expiration deadline by which the task may still be allowed to execute.

params.name: hidden
params.description: A flag indicating whether the item is hidden from common view.

params.name: hosted_zone_id
params.description: The ID of the hosted zone that ran the last task the template was used with.

params.name: linked_task_count
params.description: The number of tasks derived from the template.

params.name: organization_id
params.description: ID of the organization the template is available in.

params.name: params
params.description: A number of task parameter values. Currently there is no authoritative list of in-use values. See existing templates for examples.

params.name: parent_id
params.description: The ID of the parent entity of the task scheduled.

params.name: recur
params.description: A flag representing whether derived tasks are scheduled to repeat.

params.name: recur_frequency
params.description: A string time duration value representing execution frequency, if scheduled to repeat. You may use values including as once, hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, continuous

params.name: recur_last
params.description: Unix timestamp representing the last execution if scheduled to repeat.

params.name: recur_last_task_id
params.description: The ID of the task that last executed if scheduled to repeat.

params.name: recur_next
params.description: Unix timestamp representing the next execution if scheduled to repeat.

params.name: site_id
params.description: ID of the site the template is being used in.

params.name: size_data
params.description: The total size of result data of the last task the template was used with.

params.name: size_results
params.description: The number of results in the last task the template was used with.

params.name: size_site
params.description: The size in assets of the site the last task the template was executed against.

params.name: source_id
params.description: The numeric ID of the data source, if the task executed with this template is a runZero scan or third party data connection import.

params.name: start_time
params.description: Unix timestamp representing the next execution time.

params.name: stats
params.description: A map of statistics about the last task executed with the template. Currently there is no authoritative list of in-use values. See existing templates for examples.

params.name: status
params.description: The status of the last task using the template.

params.name: type
params.description: The type of task the template creates.

params.name: updated_at
params.description: Unix timestamp value indicating when the template was last modified.

tools.name: runzero-import_custom-integration-assets
tools.description: Assets can be discovered, imported, and merged by runZero scan tasks, first-party integrations, and third-party defined custom integrations. See [/account/custom-integrations](#/account/getAccountCustomIntegrations). Currently only assets for custom integrations are importable here. Required: orgID, assetData, customIntegrationId, importTask, siteId. Returns the new Task.

params.name: orgID
params.description: The ID of the organization to import the assets into

params.name: assetData
params.description: A gzip (not .tar.gz) compressed file containing ImportAsset objects. The file data may be a JSON array of ImportAsset objects, e.g. [{},{},...] or JSONL format, with a single JSON representation of an ImportAsset object on each new line, e.g. {}n{}n...

params.name: customIntegrationId
params.description: The unique ID of the registered custom integration which produced the asset data. Uniqueness is not checked/enforced. See /account/custom-integrations api.

params.name: importTask
params.description: Information which describes the task created when asset data is imported.

params.name: siteId
params.description: The ID of the site assets are to be imported into.
